work_items.title: Migrate runtime settlement to a durable outbox
acceptance: claim transaction commits before signer or CEX calls
stale lease generation cannot apply a result
exact duplicate receipt is idempotent
mismatched receipt fails closed
legacy transaction-held external call path is removed

acceptance: schema and canonical serialization are versioned
golden hashes cover valid and invalid transitions
contract contains no runtime authority credential

work_items.title: Implement Nakama adapter and shadow comparison
acceptance: identical fixtures produce identical state and outcome hashes
unexplained divergence blocks promotion
Nakama owns canonical ordering and restart recovery

work_items.title: Bind cross-repository component revisions and cutover evidence
acceptance: exact World and Nakama revisions are locked
active World-local matches are drained or takeover is separately proven
rollback rehearsal passes

work_items.title: Enforce protected main and required current-game checks
acceptance: direct main push is blocked
pull request and required checks are mandatory

work_items.title: Decompose game-server correctness modules

each module documents lock order and durable/public boundary
invariant-focused tests cover module interfaces

work_items.title: Publish HTTP, WebSocket and error schemas
acceptance: OpenAPI and message schemas validate implementation fixtures
stable error codes and retry semantics are documented
compatibility retirement dates are explicit

work_items.title: Specify stored-procedure API and database lock order

work_items.title: Execute settlement and authority fault matrices
